subject: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source

messages.author: dcd2782ed8819742
messages.subject: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source
parts:
Hi,
I am new to R and R Shiny. I have an application which uses 2 packages - BiocGenerics and EBImage - from Bioconductor. I installed both these packages from zip files that I downloaded from Bioconductor web site. 

When I try to deploy my application I get the below error

Uploading bundle for application: 241550...DONE
Deploying bundle: 1103747 for application: 241550 ...
Waiting for task: 497999246
  building: Parsing manifest
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 497999248 error: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source

The output of rsconnect::appDependencies() is below

        package version       source
1  BiocGenerics  0.20.0 Bioconductor
2       EBImage  4.16.0 Bioconductor
3            R6   2.2.2         CRAN
4          Rcpp 0.12.11         CRAN
5         abind   1.4-5         CRAN
6        digest  0.6.12         CRAN
7     fftwtools   0.9-8         CRAN
8     htmltools   0.3.6         CRAN
9        httpuv   1.3.5         CRAN
10         jpeg   0.1-8         CRAN
11     jsonlite     1.5         CRAN
12      lattice 0.20-33         CRAN
13       locfit 1.5-9.1         CRAN
14         mime     0.5         CRAN
15      packrat 0.4.8-1         CRAN
16          png   0.1-7         CRAN
17        shiny   1.0.5         CRAN
18  sourcetools   0.1.6         CRAN
19         tiff   0.1-5         CRAN
20       xtable   1.8-2         CRAN

Can you please let me know what I am doing wrong here. From the documentation, it seems that shinyapps supports packages installed from CRAN and Bioconductor. 

Thanks,
Swamy

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source
parts:
Installing packages locally from downloaded zip is not supported, regardless of where the zip file came from.

To install a Bioconductor package, follow the instructions here: https://www.bioconductor.org/install/#install-bioconductor-packages
